name: india-trader-skill
description: 12 Claude skills for trading NSE and BSE stocks: scan the Nifty 500 and F&O for setups, track NSE filings and news, time every entry and exit in IST, replay 10,000 sessions before you risk a rupee, size in rupees with Indian charges, a risk gate built on NSE's own circuit and surveillance data, paper-first execution for Angel One, Upstox and Groww, price and exit alerts, a results analyst, an insider and bulk-deal tracker, and a nightly shortlist of five swing and five intraday names with the exit list.
